• Punjab FC vs Mumbai City FC || Match Content || Highlights || Match 12 || 19-Oct-2026 ||
Late drama in Delhi! Watch the big moments as Punjab FC and Mumbai City FC drew 1-1 in the MG Indian Super League 2026-27. Leandro Otormín’s penalty was cancelled out by Gurkirat Singh’s header at the death. Punjab had 58% of the ball and 17 shots, but Mumbai City struck first. Otormín converted a penalty in the 65th minute. Two Punjab substitutes combined for the equaliser right at the end: Konsam Sanathoi Singh set up Gurkirat Singh, who headed home to keep Punjab unbeaten after two games.
